home.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer | Ngwaahịa & Sistemu

animated.fourth: Software a pụrụ ịdabere na ya, nsonaazụ azụmaahịa

home.footer: Atụgharịrị asụsụ webụsaịtị ugbu a na ọ dị n'asụsụ 100+!
home.descriptionA: Ọkachamara injinia zuru oke nwere ahụmịhe afọ 6+ na-ewere ngwaahịa sitere na ihe ndị a na-edoghị anya na sistemụ mmepụta a pụrụ ịdabere na ya. M na-echepụta ihe owuwu dị n'azụ React, Angular, .NET, Node.js, Java, C#, Go, na ngwa SQL: oke ọrụ doro anya, ụdị data na-adịgide adịgide, ụkpụrụ ịnweta nchekwa, na Ndị otu ụzọ nnyefe nwere ike iji obi ike rụọ ọrụ.
home.descriptionB: Ọrụ m jikọtara mkpebi injinia na nsonaazụ azụmaahịa. Site na SaaS na-eme atụmatụ na-ewu nke na-atụgharị data akwụkwọ akụkọ ka ọ bụrụ atụmatụ ndị ahịa dị njikere maka nyiwe weebụ na-enweta ego, m na-ewulite ngwanrọ gburugburu usoro ọrụ, ihe egwu, na uru bara uru bara uru maka ndị na-eji ya.

takeoff_engine.summary: Spreedṣiịt ndị na-ekwekọrịtaghị na-abanye. Atụmatụ iwu ụlọ na atụmatụ dị njikere maka onye ahịa na-apụta. Ngwaahịa SaaS ewuru gburugburu ezigbo usoro ọrụ nke onye nkwekọrịta.
takeoff_engine.lens: Mbubata na-agbanwe agbanwe chọrọ ụdị siri ike nke ime: ịnakwere ọtụtụ ụdị adịghị ekwesị igbubie iwu mgbako nke ọnụahịa dabere na ya.

inventory_register.summary: Usoro ọrụ ebe ọrụ ahịa na Angular na Node.js na-ejikọta ndị ọrụ ekwenyere, izi ezi nke ngwaahịa, na usoro ịkwụ ụgwọ emere n'ụzọ atụmatụ.
inventory_register.lens: Akwụkwọ ndekọ ego karịrị ụzọ ịkwụ ụgwọ. Ọrụ, mgbanwe ngwaahịa, na ọnọdụ ịkwụ ụgwọ chọrọ oke doro anya iji mee ka usoro ọrụ bụrụ ọrụ ọhaneze.

grocery_app.summary: Ngwa .NET 9 Blazor nwere oke njikwa, ọrụ, na repository, nkwụsi ike Entity Framework Core, na usoro nnwale zuru oke.
grocery_app.lens: Nkewa na-enweta ebe ya mgbe enwere ike ịnwale iwu azụmahịa n'adịghị adabere na interface na ọkwa nkwụsi ike.

payrollobol.summary: Ịhazi ụgwọ ọrụ GnuCOBOL na-ezute akwụkwọ ntinye abụọ SQLite na dashboard ọrụ Svelte.
payrollobol.lens: Izi ezi ego na-amalite na nnọchite anya: mgbakọ na mwepụ sent zuru ezu na ndenye ziri ezi na-eme ka ngagharị ego pụta ìhè.

interop.summary: Ntụaka asụsụ dị iche iche na-ekpuchi asụsụ mmemme 15 na usoro mmemme 18, na-enyocha ihe na-eme na oke oge ọrụ.
interop.lens: Akụkụ siri ike bụ nkwekọrịta n'etiti oge ọrụ: mgbanwe data, omume usoro, na mmemme enwere ike imegharị dị mkpa karịa syntax.

formatter.summary: Ezigbo injin parsing Go ewuru na WebAssembly. Nkwenye na ịhazi JSON na YAML na-arụ ọrụ mpaghara na browser.
formatter.lens: Ịkwaga parser na browser na-agbanwe ibu onye ọrụ ka ukwuu maka nhazi mpaghara, ịnyefegharị, na ịdabere na sava dị ntakịrị.

portfolio_website.summary: Saiti ị nọ na ya: pọtụfoliyo React nwere asụsụ 100+, mmekọrịta enwere ike ịnweta, na ngwaọrụ WebAssembly na-arụ ọrụ.
portfolio_website.lens: Ntinye static apụtaghị ahụmahụ static. Mmekọrịta bara ụba nwere ike ibi na onye ọrụ na-enweghị sava ngwa.

biblioteca.summary: Pịpụ mpaghara asụsụ Python nke na-atụgharị otu isi iyi ọdịnaya ahaziri n'ụdị pọtụfoliyo dị na asụsụ 100+.
biblioteca.lens: Iru ụwa niile bụ nsogbu ndozi data yana nsogbu ntụgharị asụsụ. Otu isi iyi eziokwu na-eme ka mgbanwe ọdịnaya nwee ike ijikwa.

personal_summary.title: Nchịkọta nkeonwe
personal_summary.text: Abụ m onye injinia zuru oke nke dabere na Orlando, FL bụ onye nwere ụzọ site na nsogbu ngwaahịa ruo nsonaazụ mmepụta. M na-eme nhọrọ teknụzụ maka ọrụ nke sistemu: NET na entlọ ọrụ Framework Core mgbe ngalaba ahaziri nke ọma yana ihe nwere ike ịnwale; Angular ma ọ bụ meghachi omume mgbe mgbagwoju anya workflows chọrọ a maintainable interface; Node.js ma ọ bụ Gaa mgbe API, ntinye, ma ọ bụ ngwá ọrụ dị elu chọrọ oge agbadoro anya. N'ofe ngwaahịa SaaS, usoro ọrụ dị n'ime, na nyiwe ndị ahịa na-eche ihu, ana m eduga na azụmaahịa doro anya, atụmatụ echedoro na nke na-agbanwe agbanwe, nnwale akpaghị aka, na omume nnyefe nke. enyemaka otu ụgbọ mmiri bara uru software na-ahapụghị arụmọrụ n'azụ.

entries.title: Injinia Stack zuru ezu
entries.text: Ana m eduga nnyefe ngwaahịa na njedebe na njedebe: ịtụgharị usoro ọrụ azụmahịa n'ime oke sistemụ, ụdị data, API, na interfaces, wee buru ọrụ ahụ site na nnwale, mbugharị, na iteration. Ebumnuche bụ sọftụwia nke otu nwere ike ịmalite ma rụọ ọrụ, ọ bụghị nchịkọta nke ihuenyo agbapụrụ.

entries.title: Ngwaahịa & Platform Architecture
entries.text: Ana m ahọrọ ikpo okwu na usoro dabere na nsogbu ahụ: ọrụ NET Layered maka ngalaba azụmahịa, ngwa Angular ma ọ bụ React na-ebugharị maka arụmọrụ dị mgbagwoju anya, mmekọrịta. ụdị data maka usoro ọrụ na-aza ajụjụ, yana njikọta emebere na ụdị ọdịda, njikwa ohere, na nrụgide n'uche.

entries.title: Mmepụta-Njikere Nnyefe
entries.text: M na-eji eziokwu eme ihe mgbe m nwesịrị echiche: ihe nzuzo echekwabara na njikwa isi mmalite, ụzọ mbugharị nchekwa data doro anya, ikike dabere na ọrụ, nkwado na oke sistemụ, ule akpaaka, imata CI/CD, yana nleba anya bara uru. Ihe ndị a bụ nkọwa na-atụgharị prototype ka ọ bụrụ ngwanrọ a pụrụ ịdabere na ya.

biblioteca.title: Akwụkwọ akụkọ JSON
biblioteca.text: Pipeline mpaghara nke dabere na Python nke na-atụgharị otu isi mmalite ọdịnaya ahaziri ka ọ bụrụ pọtụfoliyo enwere ike nweta zuru ụwa ọnụ. Ọ na-ejikwa data ntụgharị asụsụ dị ka sistemu enwere ike idobe kama iji aka degharịa ibe ibe, na-enye ohere ka saịtị ahụ wee gbasaa n'ofe asụsụ 100+ na-eme ka ụwa ruo n'ọkwa zuru ụwa ọnụ. ike ịrụ ọrụ kama ịbụ otu oge.

connect_four.title: Jikọọ anọ
connect_four.text: Ezinụlọ buru ibu nke 90+ mmemme nke egwuregwu Anọ n'ahịrị. Ọrụ a na-ekpuchi asụsụ mmemme 30+, gụnyere Java, C++, Python, na JavaScript, yana framework 50+, ọba akwụkwọ, oge ọrụ, na databases dị iche iche, site na React, Angular, na Blazor ruo Django, Spring Boot, Phoenix, PostgreSQL, na ndị ọzọ.

grocery_app.title: Ngwa ngwa nri
grocery_app.text: Ngwa zuru oke .NET 9 Blazor Server nke na-egosipụta ihe owuwu azụ azụ maka ebumnuche azụmahịa. Nkewa nke njikwa/ọrụ/ebe nchekwa na-edobe iwu ngwa, ịnweta data na ihe ngosi na-adabereghị na ya; Ngwakọta Framework Core na-enye nnọgidesi ike na-adịgide adịgide; na nke ụlọ nyocha zuru oke na-echebe omume ka ngwaahịa na-etolite.

interop.title: Interop Project
interop.text: Ntụtụ aka mmekọrịta n'asụsụ obe nke gbasara asụsụ mmemme iri na ise yana usoro mmezu iri na asatọ. Ihe oru ngo a na-enyocha ókèala ebe sistemu na-abụkarị ndị na-emebi emebi: nkwekọrịta usoro, mgbanwe data, omume oge na-aga, na ụzọ njikọta ọzọ. Ọ na-egosipụta echiche sistemụ dị mkpa mgbe ngwaahịa dị ukwuu karịa otu nchịkọta.

inventory_register.title: Ndebanye aha ngwa ahịa
inventory_register.text: POS zuru ezu na ngwa ahịa ngwa ahịa ejiri Angular 17+ na Node.js rụọ. Ọ na-egosiputa nchegbu arụ ọrụ nke sistemu B2B: ndị ọrụ akwadoro, njikwa ohere dabere na ọrụ, izi ezi ngwa ahịa, na usoro ịkwụ ụgwọ aghụghọ. Emebere oru ngo a gburugburu ọrụ otu ndị otu ndebanye aha na-arụ, ọ bụghị naanị katalọgụ nke atụmatụ.

payrollobol.title: PayrollOBOL
payrollobol.text: Usoro nhazi ụgwọ ọrụ mpaghara ewuru na GnuCOBOL, akwụkwọ ntinye abụọ SQLite, na dashboard ọrụ Svelte. Ọ na-eji mgbakọ na mwepụ sent zuru ezu, nhazi ụgwọ ọrụ batch, na dashboard loopback iji mee usoro ego ka ọ pụta ìhè, nwee ike ịnwale, na ibu ọrụ mmemme.

formatter.title: JSON & YAML Onye nhazi akpaaka
formatter.text: Ngwa nkwado JSON na YAML dabere na ihe nchọgharị wuru na Go wee chịkọta ya na WebAssembly. Ịbugharị injin ntugharị n'ime WASM na-eme ka mmekọrịta ahụ na-anabata na mpaghara na ihe nchọgharị ahụ ka ị na-etinye ezigbo nzacha iji nweta ntinye na-ezighi ezi. Ọ bụ ihe atụ lekwasịrị anya nke ịhọrọ nhazi oge ịgba ọsọ maka ịrụ ọrụ, ibugharị, na ntụkwasị obi onye ọrụ.

takeoff_engine.title: Igwe na-apụ apụ
takeoff_engine.text: Ihe owuwu na-eme atụmatụ SaaS wuru gburugburu ọnụ ahịa na-arụ ọrụ nke ndị ọrụ nkwekọrịta na-enwe mmejọ. Ngwaahịa React + Express na-etinye data CSV na Excel, maapụ kọlụm na-ekwekọghị ekwekọ n'ime ụdị ngalaba a ga-eji rụọ ọrụ, na-agbakọ ngwupụta olulu na oke ọrụ ala, na-arụ ọrụ na akara, ma na-emepụta atụmatụ PDF na Okwu dị njikere ndị ahịa. Nke a bụ injinia ndụ okirikiri ngwaahịa zuru oke: nyocha data, iwu ngụkọ, usoro ọrụ onye ọrụ na-egbu maramara, yana ihe ndị na-enyere aka azụmaahịa aka ịkwaga site na ntinye raw gaa n'ọkwa.

minecraft_json_generator.title: Minecraft JSON Generator
minecraft_json_generator.text: Igwe ọkụ JSON dị fechaa wuru na Python maka akụrụngwa Minecraft & ngwugwu data. A na-eji ọrụ a wepụta faịlụ JSON maka Mods Minecraft, gụnyere ihe omenala, ngọngọ, na ụlọ ọrụ. Ọ bara uru ọ bụghị naanị ịmepụta datapack omenala, mana maka mods yana site na njirimara mgbanwe aha mod.

educational_experience.title: Ahụmahụ agụmakwụkwọ m
educational_experience.text: N'akụkụ ọrụ nkeonwe m, enwetawokwa m ọtụtụ nkà site na ahụmahụ mmụta. Pịa ebe a ka ịlele profaịlụ LinkedIn m maka ozi ndị ọzọ.

professional_experience.title: Ahụmahụ Ọkachamara m
professional_experience.text: Afọ isii gbakwunyere ahụmịhe injinia ọkachamara n'ofe otu ngwaahịa, nyiwe azụmahịa, yana sọftụwia chere ndị ahịa ihu. Ọrụ m gụnyere iwulite ọkwa ngwa a na-echekwa, imekọ ihe n'ofe usoro nnyefe, na ịme mkpebi teknụzụ na okirikiri ndụ ngwaahịa, na-arụ ọrụ. ihe ize ndụ, na ogologo oge nwe anya.

portfolio_website.title: Patrick Goodwin Pọtụfoliyo weebụsaịtị
portfolio_website.text: Pọtụfoliyo React nwere echiche mmepụta nke na-emeso nnweta na iru ụwa dị ka ihe injinia chọrọ. Ọ gụnyere pipeline ntụgharị asụsụ enwere ike idowe maka asụsụ 100+, ngwa mmekọrịta nke WebAssembly na-akwado, ụkpụrụ UI na-anabata yana ịnweta ya, yana ihe nrụpụta ọrụ. emebere ka ọ too ka a na-ebufe ọrụ ọhụrụ.

lua_library.title: Patrick's Lua Script Library
lua_library.text: Ọbá akwụkwọ bara uru nke scripts Lua maka ntụnye aka n'ọdịnihu. A na-eji ọba akwụkwọ a na-arụ ọrụ na script Lua, nke nwere ike ịba uru maka ọrụ dị mkpa, ebe Lua na-abụkarị asụsụ scripting ngwa ngwa karịa Python na Ruby.

excel_scripts.title: Patrick's Microsoft Excel Spreadsheet Scripts (VBA)
excel_scripts.text: Ọbá akwụkwọ bara uru nke scripts VBA maka Microsoft Excel. A na-eji ọba akwụkwọ a na-arụ ọrụ na mpempe akwụkwọ Excel.

neovim_config.title: Patrick's Neovim Config
neovim_config.text: Nhazi Neovim nke m. A na-eji ọrụ a hazie Neovim ka ọ masịrị m, gụnyere igodo igodo omenala, isiokwu na plugins. A na-eji ọrụ a mee ka Neovim nwekwuo enyi na enyi na ịrụ ọrụ nke ọma maka ojiji nkeonwe m.

python_maps.title: Patrick's Map Generator
python_maps.text: Ngwá ọrụ mkpesa geospatial Python nke ejiri GeoPandas na Matplotlib rụọ iji mepụta mpaghara US na maapụ steeti. Ọ na-atụgharị data mpaghara ka ọ bụrụ ihe nyocha enwere ike ịgụ, na-egosipụta echiche pipeline data: họrọ ọba akwụkwọ ngalaba ziri ezi, hazie ndenye, wee wepụta nsonaazụ ndị ahụ. na-akwado mkpebi doro anya.

powershell_library.title: Patrick's PowerShell Script Library
powershell_library.text: Ọbá akwụkwọ bara uru nke edemede PowerShell maka ntụnye aka n'ọdịnihu. Ọ bara uru na njirimara script profaịlụ $, achọpụtara m na nke a na-enye aka nke ukwuu maka ịmegharị ọrụ site na Windows Terminal, ebe m na-eji Windows OS na-emekarị.

ruby_library.title: Patrick's Ruby Script Library
ruby_library.text: Ọbá akwụkwọ bara uru nke scripts Ruby maka ntụnye aka n'ọdịnihu. Ọ bara uru maka echiche mmepe Ruby on Rails n'ọdịnihu.

pdf_builder.title: Onye nrụpụta nka PDF
pdf_builder.text: Ọgbọ na-arụ ọrụ akwụkwọ ejiri Python, Pdfkit, Jinja2, HTML na data JSON ahaziri. Ọ na-ekewa data enwere ike iji ya na ndebiri ngosi iji mepụta PDF ahaziri ahazi, usoro bara uru maka ibelata ọrụ aka yana imepụta akwụkwọ azụmahịa. emeghari.

rijandel_encryption.title: Rijandel Encryption Project
rijandel_encryption.text: Usoro ntụnyere nke mmejuputa Rijndael 10+ gafere ụdị 128-, 192- na 256-bit. Ịmeghachi algọridim na-eche nche n'ofe asụsụ bụ mmega ahụ akwadoro na nkọwapụta, omume a na-anwale, na oke nke mbugharị ọkwa asụsụ, mmuo niile bara uru maka sistemụ na-ejikwa data dị nro.

suprememc.title: SupremeMC Minecraft Mod
suprememc.text: Mod Minecraft nke na-agbakwụnye ngwaọrụ, ihe agha, mobs, blocks, akụkụ, na ọtụtụ atụmatụ ndị ọzọ ahaziri iche na egwuregwu ahụ. Ewuru ya nke ọma na Java na Kotlin, na-akwado ụdị Minecraft 1.16 ruo 26.2.

snake.title: Egwuregwu agwọ
snake.text: Injin Agwọ mara mma ewuru na Rust na Macroquad, kwado na WebAssembly, ma gosipụta site na HTML5 Canvas. Ọ na-ejikọta tik egwuregwu 0.12-sekọnd na-agbanwe agbanwe na mmegharị interpolation dị mma, usoro egwuregwu doro anya, njikwa na-azaghachi, njikwa nkukota na ọnọdụ mmeri, na usoro nnwale lekwasịrị anya nke na-ekpuchi iwu isi egwuregwu ahụ.

tiger_programming_language.title: Asụsụ Mmemme Agụ
tiger_programming_language.text: Asụsụ mmemme na ntụgharị asụsụ arụrụ n'ime Go ka inyocha nhazi oge ojiri asụsụ, omume mmebe, yana azụmaahịa arụmọrụ. Ịchịkọta ya na WebAssembly na itinye ya na Pọtụfoliyo na-emepụta ezigbo ngwaahịa ngwaahịa maka nhazi ọkwa usoro kama ịhapụ ọrụ ahụ dị ka nnwale naanị ebe nchekwa.

tiger_tailgating_pros.title: Tiger Tailgating Uru Weebụsaịtị
tiger_tailgating_pros.text: Webụsaịtị React ewepụtara maka azụmaahịa Clemson, SC tailgating. Ọrụ ahụ na-atụgharị onyinye obere azụmaahịa ka ọ bụrụ njem ndị ahịa doro anya na ọnụnọ webụ a pụrụ ịdabere na ya, na-etinye echiche ngwaahịa iji nyere ezigbo ụlọ ọrụ aka ịtụgharị mmasị. n'ime ajụjụ na ego ha ga enweta.

turing_machine.title: Turing Machine Project
turing_machine.text: Ezinụlọ nke ihe karịrị 30+ mmemme nke Turing Machine. A na-eji egosipụta ntụgharị zuru oke maka asụsụ mmemme dị iche iche maka nyocha, ọkachasị maka Asụsụ Mmemme Tiger.

alkalab.title: Alkalab
alkalab.text: Ụlọ nyocha kemistri ntụ-aja ewuru n'ime Rust ma kwado ya na WebAssembly. See aja, mmiri, lava, igwe, calcium carbide, ma ọ bụ otu iberibe sodium ma hụ otú physics na kemistri si alụ ọgụ: sodium na-agbawa n'ime mmiri, calcium carbide na-ewepụta acetylene, lava na-agbaze aja ka ọ bụrụ iko, naanị njupụta na-ekewa mmanụ, mercury, na aja. Injin na-ahazi ihe 32 na iwu mmeghachi omume 40 n'elu buffer cell dị larịị, na-egosipụta pixels ozugbo site na ebe nchekwa wasm na-enweghị mbipụta maka otu frame.
